objective: Test whether opponent-adjusted cross-competition latent club strength improves pure-results 1X2 Top1 and whether a correctness veto improves selective Top1 accuracy.

sample.selection: latest 20000 valid completed club matches sorted by date and game_id
sample.storage: 4 CSV parts of exactly 5000 rows each
sample.same_date_update_rule: all matches on a date are predicted before any result from that date updates either model

A: same-competition venue GF/GA Bayesian pure-results baseline
B: A plus fixed 50 percent log-space blend with recency-decayed cross-competition opponent-adjusted club attack/defence latent state
C: B plus a correctness classifier trained only on gate_train; validation fixes thresholds corresponding to 90/80/70 percent target coverage; test remains untouched
